b672151e16f5c2ed.description: About Otis Otis is a global leader in elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service, moving billion people daily and maintaining approximately million customer units worldwide. The company operates in over 200 countries and territories, with a team of 72,000 professionals dedicated to meeting diverse customer and passenger needs. Otis is recognized for its legacy of innovation and commitment to safety, ethics, and quality. Role Overview Otis is seeking a Senior Project Engineer for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is responsible for managing installation projects, ensuring timely completion, and adhering to business policies and procedures. The Senior Project Engineer will oversee manpower planning, equipment requisition, and site progress monitoring, as well as manage variation orders based on client specification changes. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage Pre-installation Works: Ensure availability of contractual scope of works and deliveries information. Plan material deliveries in coordination with factory and supply chain. Monitor shaft readiness and verify dimensions against approved shop drawings. Ensure adequate resource planning to meet project requirements. Award Purchase Orders for subcontractors and local materials in conjunction with the Project Manager and supply chain. Coordinate with External Stakeholders: Facilitate approval of shop drawings, technical submittals, material samples, method statements, and Inspection and Test Plans. Plan and arrange logistic programs for safe and timely material deliveries. Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to the main contractor as required. Attend weekly/bi-weekly meetings with the main contractor. Advise the main contractor of any scope deviations and process variation orders. Carry out technical coordination and planning for elevator interface with Low Voltage devices. Oversee Installation Phase: Ensure availability of adequate resources, including subcontractors and certified tools. Raise Material Inspection Requests upon material deliveries and approval. Maintain proper communication and record-keeping with the main contractor. Monitor installation progress using MS Projects, Primavera, or spreadsheets. Plan risk assessments for hoisting, rigging, and other critical activities. Conduct Tool Box Talks (TBT)/Field Pre-Task Assessments (FPA) and ensure adherence to safety procedures. Raise trouble reports for missing, short-shipped, or defective materials and follow up on deliveries. Provide advice and support to installation teams for any related issues. Ensure installation manuals, engineering drawings, and approved shop drawings are always available. Coordinate with the supply chain for timely ordering and availability of local materials. Ensure in-stage QA/QC is carried out according to company procedures. Ensure T&C plan and adjustor availability to meet project deadlines. Ensure timely readiness of Construction Time Usage as per project requirements. Ensure timely completion of Low Voltage interfaces to elevator systems. Ensure timely submission of monthly interim payment applications and follow up on payments. Carry out third-party inspections as required. Handover units to customers in line with company policy and project requirements. Coordinate with Internal Departments: Liaise with local engineering, factory, supply chain, and finance teams to fulfill project deliveries. Manage Project Budget: Prepare and present cost reviews to finance and management teams. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in project engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex installation projects. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Projects or Primavera. Strong understanding of safety procedures and quality control. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

b6a521424b6bf18f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية بهدف تطوير المنتجات والعمليات، بالإضافة إلى تحسين الطرق التحليلية وإعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث والتجارب والتحاليل الكمية والنوعية للعناصر والمركبات العضوية واللاعضوية. تحديد الخواص الكيميائية والبنية والتفاعلات للمركبات وتحليل النتائج المستخلصة. تصميم وتطوير وسائل وأساليب وتجهيزات جديدة، وتحسين المعادلات والعمليات والطرق لحل المشكلات الفنية. إجراء الأبحاث على المنتجات الكيميائية المصنعة بهدف تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والعمليات وجودة المنتجات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بنتائج الدراسات الفيزيائية وسبل تطويرها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الكيمياء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية المعقدة. مهارات قوية في التحليل الكمي والنوعي. بيئة العمل يعمل الكيميائي بدوام كامل في الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على الابتكار والتطوير المستمر في مجال الكيمياء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل يسهم في تطوير المنتجات والعمليات الكيميائية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

b620b5fc2605271f.description: About Jazeera Paints Jazeera Paints is seeking a Driver to join their team in Al Baha. This is a full-time position focused on providing essential transportation services to support departmental operations. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient transportation services. The Driver will ensure the secure and timely transport of employees, documents, equipment, and materials as required to support the department's operational needs. Key Responsibilities Operate company vehicles safely for the transportation of staff, guests, and materials. Adhere to all traffic laws and maintain safe driving practices. Provide timely pick-up and drop-off services for employees and guests, including from airports, hotels, and other designated locations. Conduct regular inspections and maintenance checks on company vehicles to ensure optimal working condition. Report any vehicle maintenance issues promptly and coordinate necessary repairs. Plan efficient routes to maximize transportation time and fuel efficiency. Assist with the delivery and collection of HR and administrative documents, packages, and materials as instructed. Execute all assigned duties using safe and environmentally sound methods. Perform other duties as assigned by the direct supervisor or manager. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Al Baha. The role requires consistent presence and active participation in daily transportation operations. Application Process Candidates interested in this Driver position are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

b6077316a27a8ac4.description: About the Role *** is seeking an experienced MEP Project Engineer to manage and coordinate all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) installation works. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on ensuring MEP systems are delivered in compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), Civil Defense requirements, approved designs, safety standards, and project schedules, while maintaining high quality and cost control. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all on-site MEP installation activities, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and ELV systems. Coordinate MEP works with civil, structural, and architectural teams to ensure smooth interfaces and sequencing, avoiding conflicts and delays. Review and coordinate MEP shop drawings, material submittals, and technical clarifications with consultants and subcontractors. Ensure all MEP installations comply with Saudi Building Code (SBC), Saudi Civil Defense, SEC, NWC, and other relevant authority requirements. Manage and supervise MEP subcontractors and site labor to ensure productivity, quality, and safety compliance. Coordinate inspections and approvals with Saudi Civil Defense and other local authorities related to MEP systems. Support procurement activities by reviewing technical specifications and assisting in supplier and material evaluations. Monitor and report MEP installation progress against the project schedule, and coordinate testing, commissioning, and pre-commissioning activities. Identify and resolve technical, quality, safety, and progress-related issues on site, proposing constructability improvements and value engineering solutions. Identify, manage, and mitigate interface risks arising from split contracts and multiple subcontractors, maintaining a live interface risk register. Technical Coordination and Compliance The role involves ensuring that all MEP installations adhere to regulatory standards and approved designs. This includes supporting the resolution of design conflicts and site technical issues, as well as coordinating with various authorities for necessary approvals and certifications. The engineer will be responsible for ensuring materials and equipment meet approved submittals and project specifications. Subcontractor and Quality Management Effective management of MEP subcontractors and site labor is crucial to ensure productivity, quality, and safety compliance. This includes monitoring workmanship through inspections and site checks, enforcing quality standards, and ensuring adherence to approved safety plans and HSE procedures. The role also involves managing cross-trade coordination meetings to resolve interface-related conflicts. Project Progress and Documentation Monitoring and reporting MEP installation progress against the project schedule is a core responsibility. The engineer will coordinate testing, commissioning, and pre-commissioning activities for all MEP systems. Furthermore, ensuring proper documentation, including as-built drawings and O&M manuals, is prepared for handover is essential. Experience and Location This position requires 5-10 years of experience in MEP project engineering. The role is full-time and will be based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will contribute to ***'s projects by ensuring high standards of MEP installation and coordination.

b63573a777257ce0.description: About the Role Drive7 is seeking a Sales Representative to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on serving customers within the showroom, presenting automotive care products, and achieving sales targets. The company specializes in vehicle protection solutions, including Paint Protection Film (PPF) and Window Film (WF). Key Responsibilities Welcome showroom customers, identify their specific needs, and present suitable products and services. Explain the benefits and features of vehicle protection solutions, including PPF and window film. Prepare accurate price quotes, complete sales transactions, and follow up with clients to ensure satisfaction and encourage repeat business. Organize and maintain the showroom, ensuring products are ready for display and presented effectively. Coordinate with other departments to fulfill customer requests efficiently. Meet daily and monthly sales targets and deliver a professional sales experience to all customers. Compensation and Benefits The compensation package for this position includes a basic salary plus commission. Employees will also have access to professional development opportunities and ongoing training in product knowledge, customer service, and sales techniques. Work Environment The Sales Representative will operate in a supportive and dynamic work environment within the company's showroom in Riyadh.

b6567c0ecced8190.job_title: Junior Sous Chef Fast Paced Upscale Neighbourhood Restaurant
b6567c0ecced8190.description: About the Opportunity The Career Nest is partnering with an upscale, casual dining restaurant in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. This establishment is recognized for its French Riviera-inspired atmosphere, high-quality food, and warm hospitality. The restaurant is seeking a Junior Sous Chef to join its kitchen team. Role Summary The Junior Sous Chef will support the Sous Chef and Head Chef in the daily management of kitchen operations. This role involves overseeing food preparation, maintaining quality standards, and providing leadership on the line during service. This is a full-time position with a salary of 8,000 SAR monthly. Key Responsibilities Oversee food preparation, cooking, and plating to ensure precision, consistency, and quality across all sections during every service. Motivate, train, and support the kitchen brigade, leading by example and taking command of kitchen operations when necessary. Strictly enforce food safety and hygiene protocols across all stations to ensure a compliant and clean working environment. Manage inventory control, stock rotation, and kitchen flow, adapting to the demands of busy services. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 to 4 years of kitchen experience. At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a Chef de Partie or Junior Sous Chef in a fine dining or upscale restaurant environment. Strong technical culinary skills with an emphasis on consistency and organization. Demonstrated leadership potential. Required Attributes Disciplined and adaptable. Consistent in maintaining standards and composure during high-volume services. Ability to maintain focus and lead the team effectively under pressure.

b688215cb809507d.description: About Halliburton Halliburton is one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The company is committed to investing in its employees and empowering them to develop their careers. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making employment decisions without regard to various protected statuses. Role Overview Halliburton is seeking a Svc Operator II-SS to join its team in Al Qatif and Al Khobar. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves supporting service operations under direct supervision, focusing on equipment handling and documentation. Key Responsibilities Rigging-up and rigging-down of service equipment. Completing necessary documents, reports, and forms related to services performed. Potentially conducting training on the operation of equipment such as shale shakers, screen changes, centrifuges, cuttings handling and slurrification systems, and vacuum and pressure washing systems. Promoting and actively participating in quality improvement processes. Promoting safety awareness and environmental consciousness. Complying with all applicable safety and environmental procedures and regulations. Ensuring compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations and guidelines. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum of one year of relevant experience. Required Skills Ability to effectively communicate with others. Basic mathematical calculation skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division). Basic reading comprehension and writing skills. Basic computer skills are preferred. Completion of specific Baroid training is preferred. Compensation Compensation for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with experience.

b69d01ceb0c99086.description: نبذة عن الدور يقدم مصرف الراجحي فرصة وظيفية لاستشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. يشمل هذا الدور، الذي يتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المخصصة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). استقبال العملاء في الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة، مع توجيههم لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لاستخدام أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، قفل الحسابات، وتعديل بيانات الحسابات وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نماذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيعات، وإدخالها في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال التنفيذ. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. تحويل مشاكل العملاء إلى مدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة في الفرع وتوجيه العملاء لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن أي حالات مخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون المهارات الأساسية لخدمة العملاء والتعامل مع العمليات المصرفية. يجب أن تتوافر في المتقدمين المؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة إدخال البيانات المصرفية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. الالتزام بالدقة والاحترافية في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة لتطوير المهارات المصرفية وخدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مصرف الراجحي.

b6b0b379d45dc924.description: About the Role Base Career is seeking a Data QA Engineer to join a partner company based in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data delivered to customers, particularly within web data extraction projects and AI-assisted solutions. The position emphasizes early defect prevention rather than final quality checkpoints. Role Context and Responsibilities The Data QA Engineer will translate customer requirements into measurable quality standards, combining exploratory testing, data analysis, and automation. The role operates within a globally distributed, multicultural team that values ownership and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will take ownership of quality assurance from the initial stages of new projects. Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, testable criteria and comprehensive QA strategies. Perform exploratory, manual, and visual testing, complemented by automated testing where valuable. Execute test cycles on extracted datasets to validate compliance with customer specifications and identify defects. Document defects clearly, providing reproducible steps and supporting evidence for efficient resolution. Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and drift. Prepare quality reports and scoring metrics to communicate results to internal teams and customers. Identify the scope of testing, untested areas, and associated risks to support informed project decisions. Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify ambiguous requirements and ensure measurability before QA begins. Contribute to the development and improvement of test automation frameworks, focusing on coverage, reliability, and performance. Identify, propose, and implement improvements to QA processes and tooling. Work independently while maintaining close collaboration with QA leadership, developers, and project managers. Qualifications and Experience At least 5-10 years of experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable role involving software testing, data testing, or data quality assurance. Proficiency in Python for data analysis and validation, preferably using Pandas and Jupyter notebooks. Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including the ability to query and validate data in at least one relational database environment. Strong understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. Experience testing HTTP/REST APIs and validating responses against requirements. Solid knowledge of test case design, test data management, and practical approaches to exploratory and automated testing. Understanding of data quality principles, particularly completeness, accuracy, consistency, and data drift. Experience working in an Agile environment (*, Scrum or Kanban) and collaborating effectively with developers. Familiarity with AI and large language model (LLM) tools to improve test case generation and accelerate data validation workflows. A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with strong ownership of project quality and the confidence to uphold standards under delivery pressure. Ability to learn new technologies quickly, understand complex project requirements, and adapt testing strategies. Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly and precisely. Preferred Skills Practical knowledge of Scrapy or other Python-based web scraping frameworks. Experience working with test automation frameworks. An interest in data science concepts and their application to data analysis and validation. Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered approaches to improve data quality assurance. Work Environment This role is for a partner company of Base Career, which manages all applications and subsequent steps. The team is globally distributed and multicultural, promoting flexible ways of working. Application Process Applications for this position will be managed directly by Base Career's partner company. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact.

b6c5d28a4ab26c14.description: About the Role InterContinental Hotels Group is seeking a Cluster Purchasing Coordinator to manage and support all purchasing activities across its cluster hotels. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on ensuring the timely and cost-effective procurement of goods, materials, equipment, and services in alignment with IHG standards, hotel policies, and operational needs. Role Overview The Cluster Purchasing Coordinator plays a central role in maintaining efficient procurement processes. This involves cultivating strong supplier relationships, securing competitive pricing, and meticulously monitoring purchase orders. The objective is to achieve significant cost savings while consistently upholding high quality and service standards across all properties within the cluster. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily purchasing activities across all cluster properties. Receive and review purchase requisitions from various hotel departments. Obtain quotations from approved suppliers and prepare detailed price comparisons. Prepare and process purchase orders in accordance with established hotel purchasing procedures. Ensure the timely delivery of goods and services to meet operational requirements. Follow up on outstanding purchase orders and pending deliveries to prevent delays. Coordinate urgent purchasing requests with relevant departments to ensure prompt resolution. Supplier Management and Sourcing Maintain and regularly update the approved supplier database. Source potential new suppliers to ensure competitive pricing and broad product availability. Coordinate directly with suppliers regarding quotations, delivery schedules, payment terms, and product specifications. Monitor supplier performance based on quality, pricing, and adherence to delivery timelines. Maintain professional and productive relationships with both existing and potential vendors. Support supplier negotiations to achieve the most cost-effective purchasing solutions without compromising quality. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a purchasing or coordination role. Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple tasks and manage priorities effectively. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proficiency in maintaining databases and preparing comparative reports. Work Type This is a full-time position within the InterContinental Hotels Group cluster operations, requiring consistent presence and engagement to support daily purchasing functions.

b6ef500bd829563b.description: About Mace Group Mace Group combines construction expertise with consultancy services to enhance project potential and achieve ambitious goals. The company is currently providing project management consultancy services for a large luxury mixed-use development in Riyadh, KSA. The Role of Senior Manager Planning As a Senior Manager Planning, you will lead planning activities for assigned projects or packages. This part-time role involves close collaboration with the client, consultants, and contractors to ensure coordinated and on-track delivery from the design phase through to handover. Key Responsibilities Lead integrated programs encompassing design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover. Review and challenge contractor schedules to ensure realistic sequencing and achievable milestones. Monitor progress, critical paths, and delivery risks, assisting teams in developing practical recovery plans. Coordinate package interfaces, specialist fit-out, and long-lead procurement activities. Provide clear progress reports and recommendations to the client and project leadership. Lead and develop the planning team, promoting collaboration, safety, and sustainable delivery practices. Qualifications and Experience A construction or engineering degree, or an equivalent qualification. Significant planning experience on large, complex building or mixed-use developments. Advanced Primavera P6 skills and strong knowledge of progress measurement, forecasting, and schedule analysis. Experience leading planning teams and working closely with clients, consultants, and contractors. Clear communication skills and a practical approach to problem-solving. Experience in luxury hospitality, high-end residential, or mixed-use projects is an advantage. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East is also an advantage. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Information Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

b6853f331b60b885.job_title: Senior Specialist Engineering and IT Services Indirect Procurement
b6853f331b60b885.description: About the Role Savola Foods Company is seeking an Indirect & Services Procurement Supervisor to manage sourcing and contracting activities for indirect materials and services across assigned sites. This full-time role involves supporting competitive bidding, contract negotiations, and supplier performance management, with a focus on ensuring compliance and identifying cost-saving opportunities. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day operations to ensure work processes comply with established policies, processes, and procedures. Oversee overseas purchase orders and track supplier payments. Manage customs clearance for all shipments to ensure timely delivery and cost efficiency. Monitor price lists and purchase orders for compliance with company policies. Conduct periodic supplier evaluations and update the supplier list to foster competition and maximize organizational benefit. Ensure all operations are consistent with established policies, processes, and procedures. Adapt to changes in business plans or goods delivery schedules to prevent business or supplier interruptions. Procurement Management Manage sourcing and contracting activities for indirect materials and services. Support competitive bidding processes and contract negotiations. Monitor service contracts, renewal plans, and compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Support annual budgeting exercises and identify cost-saving opportunities. Maintain procurement records and reporting within Oracle Fusion. Continuous Improvement and Reporting Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in systems, processes, and practices, aligning with international best practices for cost reduction and productivity. Ensure compliance with regulations and effective implementation of standards. Prepare timely and accurate reports for department requirements, including clearance, savings, PO & PR compliance (OTIF), supplier evaluation, price plans, and credit facilities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Additional Duties Perform other related duties or assignments as directed.

b69f4d6225ee074b.description: About the Role Datamatics Technologies is seeking an experienced Platform Engineer for a contract position in Dammam, Eastern Region. This role focuses on supporting the installation, configuration, integration, and operationalization of an on-premises modern data platform. The Platform Engineer will ensure platform administration, security integration, environment management, and reliability across Development, QA, and Production environments. Role Context and Expectations The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms within highly secured environments. The position requires strong capabilities in troubleshooting, operational support, and infrastructure management to maintain platform stability and performance. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, and administer data platform components in an on-premises environment. Deploy and manage MinIO Object Storage and Apache Iceberg-based data lakehouse architecture. Install, configure, and optimize Starburst and/or Dremio platforms for data virtualization and querying. Deploy, administer, and support Apache Spark clusters and processing services. Install, configure, and manage Informatica components, ensuring seamless integration with the platform ecosystem. Configure and maintain Development, QA, and Production environments. Integrate platform components with enterprise security services, including Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Active Directory / LDAP, Single Sign-On (SSO), and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Implement and support Git-based DevOps and CI/CD practices. Manage monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness processes. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure platform stability, availability, and performance. Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, integration, and connectivity issues across the platform stack. b6c92ab1022da91c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فصول الخليج التجارية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء وترويج المنتجات، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لتقديم عروض البيع الترويجية للمنتجات والخدمات، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المندوب ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي وداعم، وستتاح له الفرصة للتفاعل المباشر مع العملاء في السوق. عن فصول الخليج التجارية فصول الخليج التجارية هي شركة تعمل في مجال التجارة، وتسعى لتقديم أفضل المنتجات والخدمات لعملائها. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو والتطور المهني لموظفيها. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل فصول الخليج التجارية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

Lakeora is an early-stage firm characterized by a flat organizational structure and a deliberately small team size. The Role of Senior Databricks Engineer Lakeora is seeking a Senior Databricks Engineer to manage the full lifecycle of Databricks implementations. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves direct client engagement from discovery and architecture design through delivery and demonstration. Engineers at Lakeora are client-facing by design, working directly with stakeholders to shape data platform strategies and present technical demonstrations that highlight value. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Design and build scalable data pipelines using Spark (PySpark and SQL) on Databricks. Lead or support technical discovery sessions with prospective clients, documenting findings and shaping solution approaches. Deliver tailored technical demonstrations on the Databricks platform, addressing both business value and technical depth. Translate client requirements into delivery scopes and effort estimates in collaboration with the team. Act as a technical lead across client engagements, from architecture design through implementation. Apply sound engineering practices, including code reviews, unit testing, Git, and Agile delivery. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the team's technical standards. Stay current on emerging trends and best practices in Databricks, Data, GenAI, and AI. Required Qualifications A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field. Preferred Qualifications Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate / Professional strongly preferred). Consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka or Spark Streaming. Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics data domains. Exposure to Data & AI regulations in Saudi Arabia. Exposure to AI and GenAI (*, Claude Code, RAG, Agents). Application Process Lakeora is an equal opportunity employer and evaluates all applications based on merit. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

b6ca12870b6f6edb.description: About the Role National Medical Care is seeking a CSSD Supervisor to oversee the daily operations of the Central Sterile Supply Department in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring the efficient processing, sterilization, and distribution of medical instruments and supplies. The supervisor will provide leadership, training, and quality oversight to maintain compliance with regulatory standards and support optimal patient care through sterile processing excellence. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily workflow and staffing assignments for decontamination, sterilization, and distribution processes. Monitor departmental productivity and turnaround times to meet surgical schedule demands. Coordinate with OR schedulers to anticipate instrument needs and prioritize processing. Manage emergency and STAT requests, ensuring rapid response times. Oversee equipment operation and maintenance schedules for sterilizers and washers. Monitor inventory levels and coordinate purchasing of supplies and materials. Manage departmental budget and control operational costs. Ensure proper storage and rotation of sterile supplies. Coordinate with biomedical engineering for equipment repairs and maintenance. Track and analyze departmental metrics and performance indicators. Maintain accurate sterilization records and quality assurance documentation. Prepare reports on departmental performance and quality indicators. Document staff training and competency assessments. Ensure proper incident reporting and corrective action documentation. Support external inspections and accreditation surveys. Collaborate with surgical services, nursing units, and other departments. Participate in hospital committees and quality improvement initiatives. Communicate effectively with medical staff regarding instrument needs. Coordinate with environmental services and infection control teams. Serve as departmental liaison for administrative meetings. Ensure compliance with Joint Commission, AAMI, CDC, and other regulatory standards. Implement and monitor quality control procedures for all sterilization processes. Conduct regular audits of instrument processing and documentation. Investigate and resolve quality issues or sterilization failures. Maintain biological and chemical indicator testing programs. Review and update departmental policies and procedures. Develop and deliver comprehensive training programs for CSSD staff. Ensure all technicians maintain required certifications and continuing education. Conduct competency assessments and skills validation. Provide specialized training on new equipment and procedures. Coordinate with infection control and other departments for cross-training. Participate in the recruitment, interview, and selection process for qualified CSSD technicians. Provide orientation and ongoing training for new and existing staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback. Create work schedules ensuring adequate coverage for all shifts. Address staff concerns and resolve workplace conflicts professionally. Recognize and reward outstanding employee performance. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of knowledge, skills, and abilities. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience in sterile processing operations. Minimum of 2-3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in a healthcare setting. Demonstrated knowledge of sterilization principles and infection control practices. Experience with regulatory compliance and quality assurance programs. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a hospital setting, requiring adherence to stringent quality assurance, infection control, and safety protocols to meet international standards such such as AAMI, APIC, AORN, OSHA, and FDA. The CSSD Supervisor will ensure the implementation of standard precautions, including the wearing of personal protective equipment (PPE) and proper handling of contaminated instruments and chemicals.

b6075b8ed3ba8405.description: About the Role كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Sr. Materials and Corrosion Engineer (Offshore) to join their team in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is crucial for maintaining the integrity and longevity of assets through specialized expertise in materials selection, corrosion prevention, and assessment. The role requires a strong technical foundation to guide decision-making and ensure compliance with Aramco and industry standards. Key Responsibilities Lead Brownfield and Greenfield Offshore Projects, serving as a technical focal point for materials engineering and managing project bids, execution, resources, and deliverables. Develop Corrosion Management Programs, Material Selection Reports, Material Selection Diagrams, Coating Selection Diagrams, and Corrosion Loop Diagrams. Conduct corrosion assessments on pipelines, piping, and equipment, with a preference for experience using ECE-5 software. Perform Non-metallic Material Studies, including assessments and material selection for appropriate non-metallic materials. Provide technical support for various disciplines and project-related tasks and workshops, including OSI, RBI, and Corrosion Inspection Manuals for operating assets and new projects. Develop and resolve Technical Queries, review and approve materials substitutions, and address site fabrication issues. Lead engineering assessments based on applicable codes such as API 579, BS DNV RP F101, ASME ******, ISO 15156, and ISO 21457. Review Technical Bid Evaluations (TBEs) and Non-Material Requirements (NMRs), primarily focusing on the materials scope. Review integrity assessment reports, which may include ILI reports, Fitness for Purpose (FFP) / Recommendations for Repair Reports (RRR), ILI raw data, and Direct Assessment reports. Assist in the training and development of junior team members. Liaise with global offices for support as needed. Conduct site visits outside offices when required. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess over 15 years of relevant experience and demonstrate proficiency in the following areas: Aramco Standards and Best Practices, NACE requirements, Material Selection, Corrosion Modelling, Damage Mechanisms, Corrosion Control, and Cathodic Protection. Experience with Water Injection, HPHT, and sour gas fields. Knowledge of APCS coating systems and internal FBE coatings. Expertise in chemical treatment, inhibitor selection, and oilfield production chemicals. Understanding of material grades, alloy selection, heat treatment, and weld engineering. Strong experience working on pre-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC, and PMC roles. Work Environment This role is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, and involves working as part of the Offshore team. The position may require occasional site visits outside the office.

b60e7d079dd329d8.description: About the Role UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company is seeking a Senior Technical Engineer for a full-time position. This role is responsible for the design management of various projects, including residential, commercial, warehouse, and industrial buildings. The Senior Technical Engineer will ensure the appropriateness of structural systems and the correctness of design criteria proposed by consultants, providing direction to ensure complete submission of structural deliverables within project schedules. Key Responsibilities Analyze and configure basic structural components to ensure design quality. Review design criteria, including basic structural components, geotechnical properties, wind loads, seismic loads, and fire protection, to ensure design adequacy. Analyze structural elements and review loading plans, ensuring compliance with codes and the project's operational purpose. Determine pressures on structural components from human use or environmental factors. Study the impact of temporary works (formwork, tower crane foundations and supports) on structural elements, providing calculations and details. Liaise with designers, including architects, to agree on safe designs that align with the aesthetic concept of the project. Provide safe structural solutions to meet architectural and MEP requirements. Coordinate and oversee all onsite material testing, ensuring compliance with specifications and codes. Ensure weekly reports detailing progress of material requirements and areas of concern/delay. Ensure accurate preparation of all shop drawings and subsequent as-built drawings. Manage the close-out of technical and material submittals, ensuring all required material submittals are prepared in advance. Lead and support teams in enhancing competencies through effective coaching and mentoring. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company policies. Design Management and Coordination This role involves reviewing structural designs, initiating value engineering exercises, and identifying potential design and construction issues early in the project lifecycle. The Senior Technical Engineer will also manage the documentation of structural drawings in coordination with architectural and MEP works. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 8 years of working experience. At least 5 years of relevant working experience. 2 years of GCC experience is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position within UrbaCon Contracting & Trading Company. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b6b3c21403ac765e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تسهيل للتقييم عن ميكانيكي سيارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص أعطال السيارات وإصلاحها، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والأجهزة وفقًا لأدلة الصيانة والتعليمات المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص أداء المعدات الكهربائية والميكانيكية للسيارات ومعايرتها بعد التركيب، مع ضمان التقيد بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية لقطع الغيار للتأكد من خلوها من الأضرار والتلفيات الخطرة، وتركيب نظم السيارات وتصليحها. التحقيق في الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات المعيبة وتصليحها أو استبدالها، ومتابعة الأعمال المنجزة. تركيب المحركات والمعدات الميكانيكية والكهربائية للسيارات وصيانتها وتصليحها. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا السيارات. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بفعالية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والأجهزة. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفرغ للعمل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. عن شركة تسهيل للتقييم تلتزم شركة تسهيل للتقييم بتقديم خدمات احترافية في مجالها، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها التشغيلية والفنية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلب التوظيف لهذه الفرصة في الخبر.

b6515000ee191108.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اصول الجودة للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة، وتحديداً في ينبع. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية وصيانتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع والمواد والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات. تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية بدقة ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها لضمان استمرارية العمل. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات لتقليل الأعطال وتحسين الأداء. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة والغاز أو مجال ميكانيكي ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وتحديد المواد والمعدات المطلوبة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وإجراءات الصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في تنفيذ مشاريع المقاولات، مع التركيز على الجودة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة اصول الجودة للمقاولات.

b657c0780f6d7a4b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فواصل المدن للمقاولات عن فني صيانة آلات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة المخططات الفنية، ومتابعة إجراءات التشغيل، وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية للآلات الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة الآلات الكهربائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الفنية المتعلقة بأعمال التركيب والصيانة للآلات الكهربائية ذات التيار المتناوب والمستمر. متابعة عمليات تركيب الآلات الكهربائية وإجراءات تشغيلها. إجراء الفحوص النهائية قبل التشغيل والفحوص الدورية للتأكد من صلاحية عمل الآلات الكهربائية، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والتأريض والدوران وارتفاع درجة الحرارة وتيار بدء الحركة. تشخيص أعطال الآلات الكهربائية وأنظمة تشغيلها، ومتابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في صيانة الآلات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية والفنية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات التشغيل والصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية للآلات الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تنفيذ المهام. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة فواصل المدن للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل في بيئة تتطلب الالتزام بالجودة ومعايير السلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيعتمد على الخبرة والمؤهلات.
